kurz: Mustard seasons and helps as an [[emulgator|emulsifier]]: a spoonful keeps a vinaigrette together much longer.
bild_im_kopf: A little helper that keeps oil and vinegar at the same table.
was_passiert: Mustard seeds contain mucilage and proteins that settle around oil droplets. That makes them run together more slowly.
faustregeln: For vinaigrette, about 1 tsp mustard to 3 tbsp oil, as a guide.
Stir mustard with vinegar and salt first, then add the oil.
